title: Kissinger consults for the Psychological Strategy Board

tellings.quote: In 1951, 1952, and again in [music] 1955, he worked as a consultant for the Psychological Strategy Board and its [music] successor, the Operations Coordinating Board.

plain: In 1951, 1952 and again in 1955, Henry Kissinger, who later became a top American diplomat, worked as a consultant for the Psychological Strategy Board, a Washington body that coordinated US psychological warfare, and for the board that replaced it, the Operations Coordinating Board. Michels tells this himself, mentioning the board's official Gordon Gray, in an episode that asks whether Kissinger oversaw a secret programme for recovering crashed UFOs.
